content.title: Where to watch Celtics vs. 76ers NBA Playoffs Game 1 today on free streams, TV
content.text: Watch Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey (0) look to lead his team to an upset of Jaylen Brown (7) and the Boston Celtics, who host the series which begins on Sunday, April 19. (AP Photo/Charles Krupa)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe 7th-seeded Philadelphia 76ers open the NBA Playoffs in Boston on Sunday with Game 1 of a series against the No. 2 seed Celtics. The game is scheduled to start at 1 p.m. ET with TV coverage on ABC and streaming on-demand.How to watch Celtics vs. 76ers on TV and stream without cable:When: Sunday, April 19 at 1 p.m. ETWhere: TD Garden, Boston, Mass.TV channel: ABCStreaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | ESPN Unlimited ($29.99/mo.)Celtics vs. 76ers: The matchupTyrese Maxey and company secured a full playoff berth early in the NBA Play-In Tournament by beating the Orlando Magic in the No. 7 vs. No. 8 play-in game. The Sixers secured that 109-97 win on their home floor without the services of Joel Embiid, whose recovery from appendicitis is likely to keep him out of Game 1 of this series. Maxey scored a game-high 31 points, and rookie guard VJ Edgecombe delivered 19 points and 11 assists to give Philadelphia a fighting shot to slay a giant in Round 1. The Celtics missed superstar Jayson Tatum for much of the regular season, but grew into a more diverse contender in his absence behind Jaylen Brown’s monster season emerging as a true No. 1 option. Tatum came back on March 6 and averaged 21.8 points, 10.0 rebounds and 5.3 assists, while Brown finished fourth in the NBA in scoring (28.7 ppg) in posting a career season. The Celtics finished with a 56-26 record and opened the NBA Playoffs as favorites (+165) to win the Eastern Conference championship.
